[[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Slightly Fast (5, Hard Mode) |hidden = No |immunity = None |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Explosion}}''' - Upon its death, the '''Eggsplosive''' would explode, stunning nearby towers for 10 seconds. |hp_multiplier = N/A }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Eggsplosive''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Eggy Island]] as part of the [[Spring 2020 Event]]. It had 40 health in easy mode and 75 health in hard mode. It had average speed in easy mode but had an above average speed in hard mode (faster than the [[Zombegg]] on both modes, but slower than the [[Sugrawr]]). When killed, the '''Eggsplosive''' would detonate its bomb, stunning all towers caught in the explosion. ==Appearance== The '''Eggsplosive''' had cyan blue skin and a smile face. It had a brown torso and legs. It wielded an egg-shaped bomb that exploded when it was killed. ==Strategy== *Avoid placing towers too close to the entrance as it is likely that they will get stunned by the '''Eggsplosive'''. *Long-range towers such as the [[Sniper]] can take down this enemy from afar, without the risk of the tower itself getting stunned. *You can use the [[Medic]]'s ability to cleanse towers if they are stunned by the '''Eggsplosive''', but this only applies in hard mode. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} NoobFace.png|'''Eggsplosive's''' face. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Eggsplosive''' behaves similarly to the [[Boomer]], as it explodes when killed. *The '''Eggsplosive''' was a portmanteau of "eggs" and "explosive". ==Update History== *'''6 April 2020''' - [[Release v1.9|Release v1.9.0]] **'''Eggsplosive''' added. *'''26 May 2020''' - [[Release v1.11|Release v1.11.0]] **'''Eggsplosive''' removed. {{EggyIsland|[[Sugrawr]]
